• **Cricket Test Match**

 
 
• The first Test match took place at the **Melbourne Cricket Ground** (MCG) in Melbourne, **Australia**.
 
• The match was played between England and Australia. The England cricket team, led by James Lillywhite Jr., toured Australia to play a series of matches against a representative Australian side.
 
• The match was a **four-day Test match.** Each team played a single innings, and the team with the highest total runs after both innings won the match.
 
• **The first Test match started on 15 March 1877 and concluded on 19 March 1877**.
 
• In a test match, a Maximum of 90 over Bolwed in a day in between these over 2 Breaks are called Lunch, Tea.
 
• In a Test match, there are 3 sessions.
 
• In a **cricket Test match, the duration of the lunch interva**l is usually **40 minutes**.
 
• The lunch break is taken after the first session of play, which typically lasts for two hours.
 
• During the lunch interval, the players leave the field and have a break to eat and rest before returning to continue the game.
 
• The duration of the lunch interval can be extended by the umpires in case of rain or other interruptions to play.

• When some other countries started playing cricket, the Imperial** Cricket **Conference was formed in 1909, which gave birth to the International** Cricket **Conference in 1956.

• The first World Cup of one-day matches was played in 1975 in London.
